objective: Remy "Two Times" wants you to speak with Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

description: <name>, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest!  Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!
I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits.  He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.
Please, <name>, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
completion: Yes, I spoke with Remy. I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.
Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
